_comment: Monday owner digest for churn-risk save plans. Reads the PMO tracker rows (the import CSV until the live list is readable) and the newest account-health log, groups open items by owner, and writes automation/logs/owner-digest-<date>.md. Outlook-routed owners get a DRAFT in Dallas's Outlook (never sent); Dallas's section is carried by the daily rundown, never a separate DM. Owners not listed here are reported under 'unrouted' and receive nothing.

Amy Johnson.email_status: inferred from the first.last pattern; the agent confirms by finding a message from this address before drafting, else logs UNCONFIRMED and skips the draft

Dallas Andrews.note: carried in the single morning Slack DM by gtm-daily-rundown (source 16); no separate DM

cadence: Mondays 7:30, after account-health-watch (7:10) and before gtm-daily-rundown (7:50)
